brief: Forensically reconstruct the genealogy of the owner of a computer in Calgary, working as a certified genealogist would, without holding the credential. Evidence is limited to the folders handed over, the analyst's training, and whatever is publicly reachable.
rules: Work one folder batch at a time. Each batch gets a blurb, new hypotheses, and a ruling on open ones.
Every fact on the tree cites a source ID. Anything else is labelled prior, inferred or lead.
Requests for more material are queued and only raised once a whole line has been processed from the folders given.
The owner's published tree and his one-name study site stay unread until the comparison phase.
Exact birth dates of living people are kept out of the public repository.
Handwriting read with doubt is marked, never smoothed over.
note: The owner may assign a different brief to other agents. This file records the brief this build was made under.
